chat.title: Ask the corpus
chat.placeholder: Ask a question about the countries in the corpus…
chat.intro: EasyRag answers from a fixed corpus of 195 country profiles (CIA World Factbook), citing its sources. Try one of these:
examples: What language is spoken in Brazil?
What is the capital of Japan?
chat.incomplete: The connection dropped before the answer finished.

error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.throttled: Too many requests — wait a moment and try again.
error.server: The server hit an error generating the answer.

hero.title: A RAG you can watch work
hero.subtitle: A fixed corpus, indexed into pgvector, answered by a local model that cites its sources. No API keys, no login.

demo.caption: Sample
demo.question: What is the terrain of Nepal?
demo.answer: Nepal runs south to north: the Tarai plain, a hill region, then the Himalayas [1] — Mount Everest tops out at 8,849 m [2].

pipeline.title: How it works
pipeline.subtitle: Four steps, all on the machine it runs on. Here is one piece of data passing through them.
pipeline.mapAlt: Route map: the landing, the archive, the survey peak, the compass rose, and the X that marks the answer.

ingest.title: Ingest
ingest.description: 195 country profiles are split into short, heading-anchored passages.
ingest.artifact: Terrain: Tarai or flat river plain of the Ganges in south, central hill region, rugged Himalayas in north

embed.title: Embed
embed.description: Each passage becomes a 384-dimension vector with a local multilingual model.

retrieve.title: Retrieve
retrieve.description: Your question is matched against every passage by cosine similarity in pgvector.

generate.title: Generate
generate.description: A local model answers from the top passages and cites them by number.
generate.artifact: "…then the Himalayas [1] — Mount Everest tops out at 8,849 m [2]."

corpus.title: The corpus
corpus.body: All 195 sovereign countries from the CIA World Factbook — public domain, shipped with the repo. Fixed: no upload, no account. Swapping in a different corpus is one command.
corpus.mapAlt: Map of the 195 corpus countries, plotted at their geographic coordinates.
corpus.mapCaption: Survey — 195 countries plotted at the coordinates on their own profile. Hover a region.

stack.title: The vessel
stack.note: No OpenAI, no hosted embedding or LLM API. It all runs in Docker on your machine.

tryIt.title: Try it
examples: What language is spoken in Brazil?
